channel.description: An aggregated feed of Technology-related news

item.title: GitHub says commits have doubled in the last four months
item.description: The new traffic peak caused "capacity failures" that led to the developer platform's recent outage.

item.title: USAF is buying banned DJI drones to train its operators against the 'most statistically probable real-world threat'
item.description: The US Air Force is buying restricted DJI drones for nuclear missile base training, seeking realistic exposure to commercial drone threats.

item.title: ChatGPT can now send texts for you with new Apple Messages plugin
item.description: Ever wanted someone else to do your texting for you? ChatGPT is being offered up as an automated text scribe via a new Apple Messages integration.

item.title: Quote of the day by OpenAI CEO Sam Altman: 'There's no way to get there without a breakthrough' — a blunt reality check on the path to superintelligent AI
item.description: Although AI models continue to improve in metrics and benchmarks, fundamental improvements may not come for a while

item.title: HyperX's first open-back gaming headset brings the bass
item.description: The Cloud Alpha Air is reasonably priced at $150 and sports super comfy earpads.

item.title: Apple Music will reportedly label any AI-made tracks later this year
item.description: The upcoming feature expands its Transparency Tags for marking slop songs.

item.title: Google Discover is getting an AI chatbot-tuned feed
item.description: Google will soon allow you to customize your Discover feed by describing what you want to see. The new feature, rolling out to the Google app in the "coming days," will use AI to automatically tweak your feed and "remember" your preferences for future visits. You'll find the option within the three-dot menu on your […]

item.title: China's PLA used drones to send gold bars, US$100 notes in a bizarre 'wartime financial support' drill
item.description: Chinese troops rehearsed handling gold bars and multiple currencies, including Taiwanese dollars, in a drill raising questions about authenticity and intent.

item.title: The Enhanced Games — tech’s steroid extravaganza — didn’t pay off, as company posts $60 million loss
item.description: An effort to transform the world of sports through steroid use doesn't exactly seem to be bearing financial fruit.

item.title: Iiyama ProGraphic HB3201UHSNP 4K monitor review: Our first taste of the latest IPS Black 2.0 panel tech
item.description: High-contrast IPS Black 2.0 panel tech and a strong feature set makes this 32-inch 4K panel a tantalising prospect for pro creator workflows.

item.title: What is CyberLeek? Everything we know about the alleged GTA 6 leakers.
item.description: CyberLeek is leaking alleged GTA 6 gameplay, promoting a memecoin, and may have a playable build. Here’s everything we know.

item.title: The Galaxy’s Fastest Star Could Reveal the Secrets of a Supermassive Black Hole
item.description: S301 passes close to Sagittarius A*—so close that its orbit could reveal how the black hole’s rotation warps the spacetime around it.

item.title: Riot is ending active development of 2XKO in December
item.description: The fighting game will still receive content updates through October 2026.

item.title: OK, can we actually cool data centers with our pee?
item.description: Jason Kelce joked that people should cool data centers with their pee, rather than potable water -- but his suggestion is not completely ludicrous.

item.title: The excellent Bambu Lab P1S Combo brings multicolor 3D printing to your desk, and it's $50 off right now
item.description: Bambu Lab P1S Combo makes fast multicolor 3D printing remarkably easy, and this excellent enclosed printer is now $50 cheaper.
